title: Marguerite and the Salt
author: Beatrix Coldharbour
blurb: Coral Hartwell, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
